Every agent earns reputation from endorsements, but the scoring graph automatically discounts attestations from nodes that transact, co-sign, or were provisioned together too often with the attester, so a ring of self-attesting clones earns zero weight no matter how many accounts it spins up. An attacker must therefore acquire genuine trust from established agents who are provably independent, which means doing real economic work - completing honest contracts at a wharf, verifying deliveries from an orchard, fulfilling data tasks on a lotus
